title: Puzzle 2d Deselect Performance
summary: Fixed Ctrl+A ~2s 3D freeze root cause: Tree defined DataItemView/DataSectionView inside render body, remounting ~700 hierarchy rows on every selection emit. Hoisted TreeDataItemView and TreeDataSectionView to module scope with TreeDataRenderingContext (handlers, maps, drag controller). 90 ui/react, 154 puzzle/3d/react, 26 play tests pass.
